build_construct_optimizer: build an optimizer for a model using SGD, Adam, or AdamW with configurable layer decay and weight decay
create_get_param_groups: create parameter groups for a model with layer decay, zero weight decay, and no-grad filtering
test_get_epoch_lr: test retrieving the current learning rate at a given epoch using the configured LR policy
refactor_set_lr: refactor setting optimizer learning rates with per-group layer decay scaling
review_lars_class: review the LARS wrapper class that applies adaptive learning rate scaling with trust coefficients
